answer: The protocol validates 1,000 distinct service slots by demanding capacity-reservations, ensuring each agent holds a unique site. A verifier probes the network, identifying any node that acts like a jagged karst of delayed relays rather than a direct connection. This zephyr of signal timing must be precise, as any detected pooling triggers a permanent lock on the deposit. An honest agent pays 1x cost; attackers pay 1,000x for isolated, non-pooled slots, with fees held as a burning ember for 60 days.
